reviews.summary: HYPE has a recurring core-contributor distribution window on November 6, 2026. Trackers model up to ~8.6–9.9M HYPE, but the project has not announced a fixed amount; actual release/transfer remains uncertain.
materialRisks: Current supply-event risk: November 6 is the scheduled monthly core-contributor distribution date. A potentially large release or transfer can increase near-term sell-side and volatility risk, even though the realized amount is discretionary and unconfirmed.

facts.fact: Blockworks lists a November 6, 2026 core-contributor cliff/distribution event of 8.60M HYPE, with the recurring cadence on the 6th of each month. ([app.blockworks.com](https://app.blockworks.com/projects/hyperliquid/token-unlocks?utm_source=openai))

A separate tracker lists 9.916667M HYPE for November 6, but characterizes this as modeled data rather than confirmed on-chain distribution. ([faro.io](https://www.faro.io/data/hype?utm_source=openai))

Recent coverage states the protocol has not announced a November amount; distributions occur on the 6th only “if any,” and prior verified monthly amounts were below the modeled ceiling. ([coindaro.com](https://www.coindaro.com/events/hype-unlock-november-2026/?utm_source=openai))
No fresh HYPE-specific exploit, protocol outage, or HYPE market delisting was identified in the reviewed current official-announcement results.
